content: This medication is not available as a single agent in the United States. For further details, refer to the drug monograph for the combination therapy of sofosbuvir, velpatasvir, and voxilaprevir. Adding plans to your list enables you to compare the formulary status of this drug with other medications within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. By adding plans, you gain the ability to: Compare formulary coverage across different plans. The information provided here is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. Please note that individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
